title: Refining one discrete point matrix into constant finite presentations
statement: Let X,Y be schemes in universe u, f:Y→X, A a commutative ring in universe u and k a commutative ring in universe u+1. Fix e:ULift A≃+*k and any ring-sheaf isomorphism c:underline k≅smallRing(X,p_X^*discreteObj A), using [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. Let N be an internal p_X^*discreteObj A-module and U an object of the coefficient-sized pro-etale site of Y [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. Put F=f^*(coefficientModelFixedScalars(smallModules(N) restricted along c)), and write u_V:V→Y for the scheme map of a site object. Fix natural numbers m,n and a map d:(discreteObj A)^m→(discreteObj A)^n of regular point modules [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. If (u_U≫f)^*N≅p_U^*coker d, there is a covering sieve S on U such that for every g:V→U in S, there is an ordinary scalar matrix q:k^m→k^n such that F restricted to the slice at V is isomorphic to the constant sheaf of coker q, with precisely the given ranks m and n. No Noetherian hypothesis on k or any scheme is imposed. This is one specified matrix before gluing local presentations. The notation for the actual finite free module, inverse-image module and point pullback is fixed in [def-sfb-point-model-free-module], [def-sfb-point-model-restriction-module], [def-sfb-point-model-pullback-functor]; these are the existing constructions, not additional hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules; Sites Tag 00YV, proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi. Forward finite-matrix part of lem-sfb-discrete-coefficient-local-models, steps 1--2.

proof.text: Apply lem-sfb-discrete-point-presentation-transport to obtain a morphism a between the constant k-module sheaves k^(Fin m) and k^(Fin n) on the slice at U, together with the given fixed-scalar module identified with its cokernel. This is the inverse-image and section-reconstruction part of the argument.

Use the proved local matrix lifting helper exists_sieve_overMap_maps in SiteFiniteConstantComplexDescent with a singleton family. Its finite-generator argument makes a locally the constant of an ordinary map q with the same domain and codomain ranks. Restriction along Over.map preserves colimits by its cocontinuous adjunction. Conjugate the restricted map by constantOverMapIso, and apply PreservesCokernel.iso, cokernel.mapIso, then the constant functor cokernel comparison to obtain the required isomorphism with the constant of coker q. If the empty sieve covers V, both module sheaves on its slice are zero; take q=0 and the unique zero-object isomorphism. This proves the conclusion for every member, including zero ranks.

lean.statement:
theorem discrete_point_presentation_refinement
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k]
    (e : ULift.{u + 1} A ≃+* k)
    (c : ConstantCompletion.constant (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X) k ≅
      smallRing X (condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) X))
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) X))
    (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y)
    (m n : ℕ)
    (d : pointModelFree (discreteObj A) m ⟶ pointModelFree (discreteObj A) n)
    (hN : Nonempty
        (pointModelRestriction (discreteObj A) f N (AsSmall.down.obj U).hom ≅
          (pointModelPullbackFunctor (discreteObj A) (AsSmall.down.obj U).left).obj (cokernel d))) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y U ∧
      ∀ (V : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y) (g : V ⟶ U), S g →
        ∃ q : ModuleCat.of k (Fin m → k) ⟶ ModuleCat.of k (Fin n → k),
          Nonempty (((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, u} f k).obj
          ((coefficientModelFixedScalars _ k).obj
            ((smallModules X (condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) X) ⋙
              ConstantCompletion.res c.hom).obj N))).over V ≅
            (constantSheaf
              ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).over V)
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)).obj (cokernel q))
